# Learn On

> A free, open-source, vendor-neutral AI curriculum — absolute beginner to
> builder. Content CC BY-SA 4.0; attribution: "Learn On contributors".

## Tracks
- Explorer (beginner): /roadmap — modules E1 (What Is AI, Really?) and
  E2 (Meet Your AI Assistants) are live; E3–E8 planned.
- Practitioner and Builder tracks: planned.

## Key lessons
- What an LLM really does: /learn/explorer/e1/l6-what-an-llm-really-does
- Why AI sounds confident when wrong: /learn/explorer/e1/l7-why-ai-sounds-confident-when-wrong
- Choosing an assistant fairly: /learn/explorer/e2/l10-choosing-your-daily-driver

## Tool registry
- Dated, community-verified fact sheets on major AI tools: /roadmap (cards embedded in E2 lessons)
